executionBackend: Bend.term_wnf over exact generated and canonical Bodies; streaming reuses source-AST lazy body_flatten audit seam; checked compiled Base JS Nat.read ABI; no canonical book_valid

canonicalObservationPolicy.isolation: one Bun subprocess per case under inherited heavy-gate lease; timeouts/errors are unobserved parity, not canonical bugs

memoryPolicy: Heavy gate owns whole-process-tree memory peaks and RESOURCE_LIMIT outcome; this report retains compact per-case rows only

counterDefinitions.transitions: actual driver Call dispatches plus Done continuations resumed
counterDefinitions.maxKont: maximum pending plus saved driver Kont list lengths at driver entry
counterDefinitions.observedTokenRewinds: original combined-token suffix activation index decreases; reconstructed lists excluded
counterDefinitions.exhaustion: zero fuel at nonterminal driver control, distinct from an invariant action

comparisonScope: complete canonical/generated SyntaxTerm/module payloads excluding spans; full alpha-normalized stage0 core declaration types, bodies, quantities, constructors, imports and metadata; diagnostics/spans separate

schemaDefinitions.syntax: generic constructor tag/fields; Nat/String/List/Bool decoded losslessly; SpanOf replaced by null and retained by AST field path
schemaDefinitions.core: all trusted LTerm constructors/semantic fields; body_flatten then term_higher/term_lower resolve Body and Sub; term_lower alpha-renumbers binders, binder spelling omitted, free names retained; missing lambda quantity is native plain/default Lone
schemaDefinitions.resolution: import aliases and relative module/import paths normalized; datatype Fill/Plus uses Base/import and preceding canonical type declarations' leading Quant parameters
schemaDefinitions.attribution: canonical/generated semantic equality establishes generator parity; canonical/native semantic or acceptance mismatch is canonical bug; spans/diagnostics are debt

limits: bounded representative corpus, not whole-parser equivalence
no type checking of parsed fixture programs
template specialization/binders are explicitly unsupported by the core bridge, never PASS
core spans compare lowered-tree paths; canonical syntax spans remain separately recorded
native book_load strips import header text, so its later offsets can differ
canonical timeout/error prevents generator attribution for that case
fuel is a fixed explicit administrative driver input, not an automatic sizing policy
